data.name: Settings.Overview.Description
data.value: Manage independent workspaces on each monitor.

data.name: Settings.Overview.MonitorsHint
data.value: The filled circle is the active workspace.

data.name: Settings.Overview.IndicatorStatus.Desc
data.value: Shows existing workspaces on each monitor.

data.name: Settings.Overview.StartWithWindows.Desc
data.value: Run Spaces4Win after you sign in.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Description
data.value: Sparse workspaces are created when you press Caps Lock + a number.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Hint.Access
data.value: Caps Lock + 1–9 switches to that workspace on the monitor under the cursor.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Hint.Create
data.value: If the number does not exist, it is created on demand.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Hint.Sparse
data.value: Intermediate numbers are not created automatically.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Delete.Blocked
data.value: Cannot delete the only workspace on this monitor.

data.name: Settings.Workspaces.Delete.Confirm
data.value: Delete workspace {0}? Windows will move to workspace {1}.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Switch.Desc
data.value: Switch or create workspace {0} on the monitor under the cursor.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Move.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to workspace {0} (stay on the current workspace).

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveFollow.Name
data.value: Move window and follow to workspace {0}

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveFollow.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to workspace {0} and switch there with it.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.ShiftLeft.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window into a new workspace to the left, renumber, and stay on the current workspace.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.ShiftRight.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window into a new workspace to the right, renumber, and stay on the current workspace.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.ShiftFollowLeft.Desc
data.value: Insert a new workspace to the left with the focused window, renumber, and switch there.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.ShiftFollowRight.Desc
data.value: Insert a new workspace to the right with the focused window, renumber, and switch there.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveAdjacentLeft.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to the previous existing workspace without switching. Does nothing at the edge.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveAdjacentRight.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to the next existing workspace without switching. Does nothing at the edge.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveAdjacentFollowLeft.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to the previous workspace and switch there. Creates a new workspace at the left edge.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveAdjacentFollowRight.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to the next workspace and switch there. Creates a new workspace at the right edge.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Last.Desc
data.value: Tap to toggle the previous workspace. Hold CapsLock and press Tab again to cycle through workspaces.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.WindowSwitcher.Desc
data.value: Hold CapsLock+Q to cycle windows on the current workspace (release CapsLock to activate). Tap once to flip between the two most recent.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Previous.Desc
data.value: Switch to the previous existing workspace. Does nothing if none.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Next.Desc
data.value: Switch to the next existing workspace. Does nothing if none.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.FocusPrevMonitor.Desc
data.value: Move the cursor to the previous monitor so workspace hotkeys target that display.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.FocusNextMonitor.Desc
data.value: Move the cursor to the next monitor so workspace hotkeys target that display.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Compact.Desc
data.value: Renumber sparse workspace ids densely to 1…N on the target monitor.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Fullscreen.Desc
data.value: Enter or exit borderless fullscreen for the focused window (stays on the current workspace).

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveFree.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to a free workspace without switching to it.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveFreeFollow.Name
data.value: Send to free workspace and follow

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.MoveFreeFollow.Desc
data.value: Move the focused window to a free workspace and switch to that workspace.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Delete.Desc
data.value: Delete the active workspace and move its windows.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Overview.Desc
data.value: Open the workspace overview on all monitors.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.Sticky.Desc
data.value: Keep the focused window visible on all workspaces.

data.name: Settings.Hotkeys.EditSoon
data.value: Editing will be available in a future update.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Description
data.value: Floating workspace dots on each monitor.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Enabled.Description
data.value: Display a compact overlay with existing workspaces.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Opacity.Description
data.value: How transparent the indicator capsule appears.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Scale.Description
data.value: Scale of the indicator relative to the default size.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Animations.Description
data.value: Briefly highlight the active workspace when switching.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.Fullscreen.Description
data.value: Temporarily hide the indicator over exclusive fullscreen apps (experimental).

data.name: Settings.Indicators.PinnedMode.Description
data.value: How the floating indicator shows that the active window is pinned across workspaces.

data.name: Settings.Indicators.MoveHint
data.value: Drag the indicators, then press the same button again to finish. Esc cancels.

data.name: Settings.Appearance.ReduceMotion.Description
data.value: Disable decorative animations in the interface.

data.name: Settings.Appearance.Animations.Description
data.value: Controls overview (all monitors), floating indicator, and UI motion. The Windows global setting takes priority when following the system.

data.name: Settings.Appearance.Transition.Style.Description
data.value: Window switching is instant. Feedback is a light indicator with the workspace number.

data.name: Settings.Appearance.Transition.Speed.Description
data.value: How quickly the workspace indicator appears and fades.

data.name: Overview.EscHint
data.value: Esc to close · Ctrl+F search · drag to move

data.name: Overview.DropCreateHint
data.value: Drop here to create a new workspace

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Description
data.value: How Spaces4Win manages windows and workspaces.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Sticky.Description
data.value: Sticky windows stay visible across all workspaces on a monitor.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Switcher.Title
data.value: Hide inactive from Alt+Tab and taskbar

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Switcher.Description
data.value: Uses SW_HIDE instead of cloaking. Inactive windows leave Alt+Tab and the taskbar; clicking a taskbar icon will not jump to a hidden workspace. Snap size may change when showing again.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.SingleFullscreen.Description
data.value: When enabled, a workspace may have only one borderless fullscreen window. Moving another window into that workspace exits the existing fullscreen so both stay visible on the taskbar.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Overview.Description
data.value: Overview shows live thumbnails of windows on every connected monitor.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Ignored.Description
data.value: Custom ignore lists will be configurable in a future update. Helper and system windows without a real UI are already filtered out automatically.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Deletion.Description
data.value: Windows move to the previous workspace number, or the next one if none exists. The last workspace cannot be deleted.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Shutdown.Description
data.value: Windows on inactive workspaces return minimized to the taskbar without stealing focus. Active workspace windows stay as they are.

data.name: Settings.Behavior.Advanced.Description
data.value: Low-level window management options will appear here as they become available.

data.name: Settings.Startup.StartWithWindows.Description
data.value: Starts Spaces4Win at sign-in via Task Scheduler. With “Always run as administrator”, the task is elevated so login needs no UAC prompt.

data.name: Settings.Administration.Ask
data.value: Ask when an admin window is blocked

data.name: Settings.Administration.Always.Desc
data.value: Restarts Spaces4Win elevated (one UAC when you open it). With Start with Windows, also registers an elevated logon task so the next sign-in needs no UAC.

data.name: Settings.Administration.WhyBody
data.value: Windows prevents a standard app from controlling windows that run as administrator. Restarting Spaces4Win elevated lets it manage those windows. You can also choose never to prompt and leave admin windows alone.

data.name: Settings.Administration.AlreadyAdmin
data.value: Spaces4Win is already running as administrator.
